ted_duffield.title: Republican primary candidates battle for Bell County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 1
ted_duffield.excerpt: Duffield is not seeking re-election; Patrick Patterson and Joseph Agee ran in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary to succeed him (Feb. 14, 2026).

ted_duffield.title: Patterson leads Justice of the Peace Precinct 1 race; Sapp, Tice lead four-way JP race
ted_duffield.excerpt: Duffield will finish his eighth term and serve through Dec. 31, 2026 (Mar. 3, 2026).

ted_duffield.title: Bell County rings in new year by swearing in elected officials
ted_duffield.excerpt: Bell County's elected officials, including its justices of the peace, were sworn in on Jan. 1, 2025.

rosanne_fisher.title: Bell County rings in new year by swearing in elected officials
rosanne_fisher.excerpt: Justice of the Peace Precinct 3, Place 1 Rosanne Fisher was sworn in on Jan. 1, 2025 for a four-year term.

larry_wilkey.title: Wilkey announces 2026 campaign for Precinct 3, Place 2 Justice of the Peace
larry_wilkey.excerpt: Wilkey retired from the Temple Police Department on June 22, 2022 and was sworn into office on June 23, 2022; his precinct covers Little River-Academy, Rogers, Temple and Troy (Nov. 26, 2025).

larry_wilkey.title: Bell County primary ballot features several uncontested races
larry_wilkey.excerpt: Wilkey is the only candidate for Precinct 3, Place 2 in 2026, unopposed in the Republican primary and the general election (Feb. 14, 2026).

gregory_johnson.title: Justice of the Peace Gregory Johnson to kick off re-election campaign in downtown Killeen
gregory_johnson.excerpt: Johnson, a Democrat first elected in 2020 and a former two-term Killeen City Council member, launched his 2024 re-election campaign (July 25, 2024).

gregory_johnson.title: Judge Johnson wins re-election in JP race
gregory_johnson.excerpt: Johnson won re-election to Precinct 4, Place 1 on Nov. 5, 2024 with about 57.5 percent of the vote.

gregory_johnson.title: Bell County rings in new year by swearing in elected officials
gregory_johnson.excerpt: Johnson was sworn in for a new four-year term on Jan. 1, 2025.

nicola_j_james.title: Judge Nicola James to seek re-election to Bell County Precinct 4, Place 2 JP post
nicola_j_james.excerpt: James, elected in 2022 to replace Bill Cooke and a former court administrator in Copperas Cove, announced her re-election bid (Nov. 1, 2025).

nicola_j_james.title: JP for Killeen: Quarles, Gonzalez head to runoff election as incumbent finishes 3rd
nicola_j_james.excerpt: James finished third of three in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 27.86 percent.

beatrice_bea_cox.title: Cox and Gonzalez participate in Justice of the Peace forum ahead of Nov. 3 election
beatrice_bea_cox.excerpt: Cox, the Bell County truancy master with more than 20 years in the JP office, and Gonzalez took questions at a candidate forum (Oct. 7, 2026).

jessica_a_gonzalez.title: Gonzalez, a Killeen councilwoman, wins Democratic JP primary runoff
jessica_a_gonzalez.excerpt: Gonzalez won the May 26, 2026 runoff over Quarles, 1,233 to 1,171.

michael_tice.title: Low turnout, high stakes: Bell County Republicans lean conservative in runoff election
michael_tice.excerpt: Tice defeated Richard Sapp in the May 26, 2026 Republican runoff, 1,286 votes to 1,111.

thomas_smith.title: Texas Court of Criminal Appeals 2026 election: who is running
thomas_smith.excerpt: States Newsroom explainer on the Court of Criminal Appeals races, cited in the profile.
